```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: C13-zdnhv
vectorfield_plot(y ~ 1/(x-6), x ~ x-1 , 
                 domain(y = 0:5, x = 0:5),
                 npts = 9,
                 stretch = 0.8) |>
  gf_theme(theme_minimal(base_size = 14)) |>
  gf_refine(coord_fixed())
```

1. `r devoirsTF(TRUE, id="flow-ftb-1-k3")` The y-component of the flow depends on the value of x.

2. `r devoirsTF(FALSE, id="flow-ftb-2-ws")` The x-component of the flow depends strongly on the value of y.

3. `r devoirsTF(TRUE, id="flow-ftb-3-8d")` The x-component of the flow depends strongly on the value of x.

4. `r devoirsTF(FALSE, id="flow-ftb-4-is")` The y-component of the flow depends on the value of y.
:::
